headline: The recipe search screen now offers a saved light or dark display mode and is safe to ship.
what_changed: Customers can switch the Recipe Box screen between light and dark display modes.
The app remembers each customer’s choice on their device.
New visitors start with the display mode their device prefers.

risks.title: Brief light-mode flash
risks.explanation: Customers who prefer dark mode may briefly see the light screen when the page first opens. This is most noticeable on slower devices and does not affect recipes or searches. A developer can avoid it by applying the saved choice before the page first appears.

good_news: The choice is stored only on the customer’s own device and is not sent to a company service.
The change is small and does not alter recipe search or recipe data.
